name: Philips Hue
title: Philips Hue: the lights at home through the Hue cloud, by name, colour and scene

permissions: turns the person's Philips Hue lights, rooms and zones on and off and changes their brightness, colour and colour temperature, and activates their scenes, through the Hue cloud, when they ask in a conversation
